outline: When a teammate receives the ball and faces pressure from an opponent, move to create passing and shooting options. Either receive the ball and dribble upwards to take a shot, or pass the ball ahead to assist in further play, depending on the situation.

target.info: Move to the side to create a clear passing path and a potential shooting angle.

nodes.info: Move to the side to create a clear passing path and a potential shooting angle.
nodes.termination: Position yourself with a clear pass option for your teammate while maintaining a shooting angle.

nodes.info: Wait to receive the ball from the teammate.
nodes.termination: Receive the pass from the teammate.

target.info: Dribble the ball upwards after receiving it.

nodes.info: Dribble the ball upwards after receiving it.
nodes.termination: Position yourself for a shot after moving upwards.

nodes.info: Take a shot at the goal.
Pass the ball ahead of the teammate to facilitate further play.
nodes.termination: Stop when the ball is successfully passed to the teammate.

edges.condition: Teammate passes the ball to you.
Receive the ball from the teammate.
Positioned appropriately for a shot after dribbling.
Coach has possession of the ball after receiving a pass from the teammate.
